newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Rep. Hinchey accuses Fed of "fighting ghosts".
newsitem.headline: U.S. Rep. Hinchey accuses Fed of "fighting ghosts".

text.p: U.S. Rep. Maurice Hinchey, a Democratic member of the House Banking Committee, on Tuesday criticized the Federal Reserve's decision to raise a key interest rate, saying the central bank was fighting ghosts.

"The Fed is fighting the ghost of inflation, and in the process is dampening wage growth and denying many families the opportunity to share in the economy recovery," Hinchey said in a statement issued shortly after Fed's announcement of a quarter-point rise in the federal funds rate.
Hinchey said that he and Texas Rep. Henry Gonzalez, the banking panel's ranking Democrat, would take steps to try to make the Fed more accountable to Congress and the public.
Hinchey, of New York, also serves on Congress's Joint Economic Committee.
